title: PieceWork
creator: tegar07257
summary: MIT-licensed Rust milestone-escrow template source with a walletless browser simulation. The creator describes a fixed payee, client funding and approval, payee delivery marking, and refunds of unreleased funds after an epoch deadline. November 18, 2026: the public README explicitly says the template is unpublished on Esmeralda and mainnet, and the simulation uses pretend balances. The creator reports engine tests; no code, wallet or transaction was run here. The linked demo could not be extracted by the server-side reader in this review. This recording is a continuous walkthrough of the public README.
cardSummary: Model freelance milestone payments with client approval, fixed payees and refunds for unreleased funds after the agreement deadline.
